content: CitraNatal DHA is a prescription multivitamin and mineral supplement designed to improve the nutritional status of women before conception, during pregnancy, and in the postnatal period for both lactating and non-lactating mothers. The recommended dosage is one tablet and one soft gel daily or as directed by a physician. This product is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any of its ingredients. Ingestion of more than 3 grams of omega-3 fatty acids per day may have antithrombotic effects, including increased bleeding time and INR. Omega-3 fatty acids should be avoided in patients on anticoagulants or those with inherited or acquired bleeding disorders. Folic acid alone is not an appropriate treatment for pernicious anemia or other megaloblastic anemias caused by vitamin B12 deficiency, as it may mask hematologic remission while allowing neurological symptoms to progress. Allergic sensitization has been reported following both oral and parenteral administration of folic acid. There is limited information regarding postmarketing experience, drug interactions, and pharmacology, including pharmacodynamics and pharmacokinetics, of CitraNatal DHA. CitraNatal DHA is supplied as a white, scored, oval multivitamin/mineral tablet debossed with CN 1 on one side and blank on the other, along with a caramel-colored soft gel containing DHA. The product is packaged in six child-resistant blister packs, each containing five tablets and five soft gels. The product should be stored at 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F), with permitted excursions between 15°C and 30°C (59°F to 86°F). Brief exposure to temperatures up to 40°C (104°F) may be tolerated if the mean kinetic temperature does not exceed 25°C (77°F). Contact with moisture can discolor or erode the tablet. There is no established FDA guidance on the use of CitraNatal DHA in specific populations, including pediatric, geriatric, gender-specific, racial, renal impairment, hepatic impairment, or immunocompromised patients. Similarly, there is no FDA guidance on its use during pregnancy, labor and delivery, or in nursing mothers. The interaction between alcohol and CitraNatal DHA has not been established, and patients are advised to consult their healthcare provider regarding alcohol consumption while taking this medication. CitraNatal DHA is a prenatal/postnatal multivitamin/mineral supplement that includes Ferr-Ease®, a patented dual-iron delivery system with both quick-release and slow-release iron, and an essential fatty acid soft gel. The DHA soft gel contains a light yellow to orange semi-solid mixture. For any serious adverse events or product information, patients are advised to call (210) 696-8400. It is recommended to consult a healthcare provider for any dietary concerns.
